notes:
First example of [4,12] = Z/4 x Z/12 for a geometrically simple genus 2 Jacobian over Q (previously known only for Jacobians split over Q).

Output of pipeline/magma/prepare_submission.m (Magma V2.29-4): J(Q)_tors = [4,12]; gcd of #J(F_p) over 25 good primes = 48 (sharp); strict prime 31, chi = x^4 + 8*x^3 + 30*x^2 + 248*x + 961; conductor 8430300 = 2^2*3^2*5^2*17*19*29. Independent PARI/GP check (hyperellcharpoly): gcd 48 over 103 good odd p < 600, 10 strict primes below 200. Sage/Lombardo: End(J_Qbar) = Z. #Aut(C) = 2.

How it was found: by a search on the order-12 chart A(12), written in coordinates (A,z,B) = (p^2, z, p*r), restricted to the plane A = 1/4, where all three 2-torsion points are rational. The curve is at (A,z,B) = (1/4, 10/3, 127/36). Eleven further pairwise non-isomorphic simple [4,12] curves were found on the same plane; no infinite family is known.
